title: Implementation Handoff Payload
description: Structured payload submitted by IMPLEMENTATION when a Ticket reaches READY_FOR_REVIEW. Mirrors implementation-audit's Verification Evidence and Handoff Completeness criteria.

changes.description: Main files changed and what changed in behavior.

verification.description: Reproducible verification steps per implementation-audit, Verification Evidence.

step.description: The command or action actually run.

status.description: UNVERIFIED is mandatory (not PASS) for anything that could not actually be executed, per implementation-audit Exception Handling. A step the Developer knows failed is not submitted in a Handoff: it must be fixed and re-verified, or the Ticket is not yet ready for REVIEW.

dependencies.description: Modules, interfaces or shared components this Ticket added, changed, or directly depends on. Navigation aid only, not a full dependency graph (Harness main document, section 12).
